mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and causes negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp in a month, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a contraction in economic demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits decline.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% and GDPC1 decline > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: When HOUST declines > 0.5% and GDPC1 declines > 0.1% in 3 months, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year) signals an impending Federal Reserve tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% yoy, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates a slowdown in manufacturing and services, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and causes negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts above 1200.0 thousand units signal robust consumer spending and business investment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200.0, the S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.1% and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines > 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production above 108.0 indicates economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 108.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.
